Wang Ting participates in the school's art exhibition, and her artwork receives an award. After the exhibition ends, she puts the certificate in her backpack, but she thinks she hangs the certificate on the wall. In the evening, her mother asks, "Where is your certificate?" Wang Ting's reply, "It hangs on the wall, Mom."

[Question]
Why does Wang Ting say this?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Wang Ting forgets she puts the certificate in her backpack.
B. Wang Ting deliberately lies because she does not want her mother to know the certificate is still in the backpack.
C. Wang Ting remembers the certificate is on the wall.
D. Wang Ting wants to test whether her mother pays attention to her exhibition results.
